slides.s: PMP-Certified Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Engineering Transformation
slides.n: Welcome to {name}'s professional journey. With 21 years of progressive experience, {he} has built a career spanning software development, testing, DevOps, and engineering leadership, most recently driving AI-enabled transformation across enterprise products.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, cut upgrade time by ~90%, drove security hardening, and built 7-8 agentic AI agents for CVE remediation and bug fixes.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Owned architecture and delivery of Webex-Microsoft Teams presence/calling integration using Kafka, Redis, and Java; led AI-driven code generation initiatives for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led developers, testers and release engineers on Cisco Expressway, driving Python/C++ platform features, OS upgrades, and DevOps-based release infrastructure.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Owned functional and regression testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, handled customer escalations with SIP/H.323/RTP troubleshooting, and drove automation coverage toward 100%.
Verizon India Pvt Ltd · May 2007-Mar 2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow, regression testing and bug verification for IP-converged contact center solutions including IVR and prepaid dialing.
slides.n: {His} career spans over two decades, evolving from hands-on QA and protocol testing to leading engineering teams building distributed, AI-enabled products. Each role deepened {his} expertise in delivery, architecture, and team leadership.
{Name}'s toolkit blends deep technical grounding in VoIP and programming with modern AI and DevOps expertise, all anchored by strong PMP-certified engineering leadership.
These numbers reflect the tangible impact {name} has delivered—from leading sizable teams to driving major efficiency and security improvements across enterprise platforms.

{His} academic foundation in electronics and communication was strengthened by a PMP certification and a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence, reflecting {his} ongoing commitment to learning.

slides.s: Let's Build the Future of AI-Driven Engineering Together
slides.n: That concludes {name}'s journey—a story of steady growth, technical depth, and a passion for driving AI-powered transformation in engineering. Thank you for taking the time to learn about {his} career.
